notes.title: Minor Patch (2024-03-18)
notes.content: Adjust level7(water level)'s books locations. -> now it is much easier to find them!

notes.title: (2024-03-07) Main patch
notes.content:
Upgraded engine's version from 5.2 to 5.3. 
-Level69 become much easier than before! - removed most of the boring walking parts.
-Added special effect to level19. Check this one out!

notes.title: (2024-03-06)#2 Minor patch
notes.content: Some adjustments on level19's puzzle difficulty.

notes.title: (2024-03-06) Critical bug patch
notes.content: -Strange big white block at level19(wood level). -> now removed.

notes.title: (2024-02-22) Minor Patch
notes.content:
-Fixed some "Unintended" routes on level19.
-Fixed sound issue on level69
-Fixed door bugs on level231

notes.title: (2024-02-13) Minor patch
notes.content: level19's vhs bug has been fixed.

notes.title: (2024-02-13) Minor patch - Bug Fix
notes.content: Level 7's Water shader problem has resolved.

notes.title: (2024-02-10) Minor patch
notes.content: Now "Most of" clappers are not moving. However, they become numerous than before. [i][b]Have a good time in Room231![/b][/i]

notes.title: (2024-01-31) Sound Bug Patch
notes.content: Couldn't reduce some volumes like radio, background music - Now fixed.

notes.title: (2024-01-31) Minor Bug Fix Patch
notes.content:
There was some bugs on level19- now fixed
- Can't get vhs in drawer- fixed

notes.title: (2024-01-31) Minor Patch - Difficulty Adjustment
notes.content:
Now Level 231 Become easier than before:
- Some buttons are become easier to find than before.
- Now you can see clear difference at clapper's map.

notes.title: (2024-01-29) Minor Bug fix Patch
notes.content: There were some bugs at level19(Night vision camera map)- Now fixed

notes.title: (2024-01-29) Minor Patch - Difficulty Adjustments
notes.content:
Now clapper's movement speeds are decreased - Have a good time at art gallery!

Level19 & Doormaze level become little bit easier than before - Some adjustments on papers.

Buttons on Level69 are become easier to find.

notes.title: (2024-01-23) Minor bug fix patch & Level19 difficulty adjustments
notes.content:
-Fixed some minor bugs on level19 and level34.
-[b]Now Level19 become little bit easier than before! (Especially the room with the painting)[/b]

notes.title: (2024-01-21) Sound bug patch & Difficulty adjustments

- Fixed Ambient sound bug
- Now level69 become easier than before.
